about_the_game:
Let your heroes enjoy a day of fun with the KR Amusement Park Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a new MV/MZ-sized tileset filled with modern carnival rides to turn any empty field into a fantastic fairground! A1, A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets are ready to build bright tents and buildings where fun games and sweet treats are everywhere the eye can see. Build a cozy party in a city park where wooden picnic tables are set up near small grills and inflatable bouncy castles surround colorful play structures so the kids can have tons of fun while the adults chat. Or have a traveling circus come to town for a few weeks in the middle of your slice-of-life game to break up the monotony of farming! Let your players decide if they want to visit the food stalls to buy all sorts of candies and fried food, or spend their time in the rows of games where they can test their skills at ring toss, darts, tests of strength, and more to win prizes.

This pack also includes 5 character sprites for doors and bathroom stalls so your heroes and NPCs can have some privacy, along with 10 sprites of rides and more to add spinning and twirling fun to your maps! Have a ticket booth with swinging gate keep your players from rushing onto rides before buying tickets, and decorate the paths with bouncing balloons that lead your heroes to a massive merry-go-round, towering ferris wheel, whirling pendulum ride, and spinning tilt-a-whirl where they can have fun and maybe even gain a stat buff. Pick up the KR Amusement Park Tileset and build a carnival where anything can happen!


This Amusement Park Tileset Includes:

Ground Tiles:

Several water tiles
sand, dirt, various grass textures to make the land look more natural
stone, wood and tile
tables and fences
wildflower patch
puddle tiles
and more!

Walls:

terra cotta tile roofs in natural tones, plus red and gold
walls in brown, concrete, wood, plain white, metal panel, red marble, yellow with red stripe
adjustable width windows
cliff face
and more!

Carnival rides and games:

ferris wheel
ring toss
duck game
tilt-a-whirl
dunk tank
merry-go-round
frog jump
kamikaze
dart game
knock down bottles
bounce houses
playground equipment
and more!

And more goodies to round things out:

souvenir shop
two stages, one large, one small
concession stands – cotton candy, corn dogs, fried food and more
vending machines
ticket booth with animated turnstile
picnic benches
large lights with adjustable length pole
awnings
buntings
umbrella
balloons (with animations)
pinwheel (with animation)
road-building kit
grills
tons of food tiles, some dumped on the ground
and more!


Events and Animations

ferris wheel
frog jump
merry-go-round
pinwheel and balloons
ticket booth/turnstile
kamikaze
tilt-a-whirl
big doors and small doors
bathroom stalls
20+ animations to make your maps alive!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
